tags.description:
The VCU Pep Band, is from Virginia Commonwealth University. The pep band plays for both the VCU Men's and Women's Basketball teams at all home games as well as various other school sporting events and events around Richmond, VA.
They now have been enslaved by the Scumdogs of the Universe. The end.
